title: Actual coefficient-system reindexing laws before total-limit realization
statement: For a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y and the coefficient systems attached to l and E, the exact reindexing functor satisfies all system-level equivalence, K-injective, K-flat, internal-Hom, evaluation, cartesian reduction, ambient beta-square, and reduction/limit adjunction identities collected in PodSystemReindexingLaws l E g.

proof.text: Relabel the sequence site by the pro-etale equivalence induced by g, preserving the inverse-sequence index and coefficient quotient arrows. The reverse relabelling is an exact inverse equivalence, so derived equivalence and transport of K-injective and independent-coefficient K-flat complexes follow. Reindex the simultaneous product-Hom complex; its signed differential and evaluation on pure tensors are unchanged. Closed adjunction and transpose uniqueness give the Hom comparison, finite evaluation and scalar-reduction formulas, the ambient beta square, and the unit/counit identities before limit realization.
